headline: Profitability jumps operationally, but net income falls
summary_short: Casey's reported operating income up 51.0% y/y to $235M and EBITDA up 33.2% y/y to $350M, while net income fell 24.5% y/y to $163M even as revenue was roughly flat y/y at $4,572M (+0.1%). Sequentially, revenue rose 16.7% and net income rose 25.1% q/q.
summary_long: The 10-K covers fiscal year ended April 30, 2026; it discusses only annual results, not this discrete quarter. Full-year revenue rose 10.2% to about $17.5B, mainly from a full year of the Fikes wholesale-fuel acquisition plus same-store sales gains in prepared food (+5.2%) and grocery (+3.9%). Full-year net income rose 30.7% to $714M on higher inside-store and fuel margins, partly offset by higher operating expenses, depreciation and interest. Fuel margin per gallon improved to 42.6¢ from 38.7¢. Annual capex plus acquisitions totaled $798M; the company bought back $202M of stock and declared $2.28/share in dividends for the year, with the board setting the next quarterly dividend at $0.65/share. Current ratio was 1.01:1 at fiscal year-end. No forward guidance was given.
